title: Rory and the Sleepy Lantern Ferns
verses:
The moon showed its light in the dim evening sky,
While clouds made of purple went drifting on by.
Now Rory walked down to the edge of the stream,
All ready to rest in a sleepy sweet dream.

Nia swooped down through the cool evening air,
She spotted a bed made of moss over there.
Psittaco chirped from a warm tiny nest,
Telling the friends it was time for some rest.

Tilly sat down by a bundle of fern,
Watching the glowing bright fireflies turn.
Benny stretched out his long neck to the sky,
Singing a song as the breeze drifted by.

Ricky rolled over and started to yawn,
Knowing they all would sleep soundly till dawn.
Rory tucked under a blanket of green,
Softest soft petals that ever were seen.

The leaves rustled soft as the night wind blew through,
The grass was all covered in cool silver dew.
Everyone snuggled up cozy and tight,
Ready to welcome the quiet of night.

The stars gave a wink from the heavens so deep,
As all of the dinos fell fast into sleep.
Rory closed eyes in the warm gentle glow,
Dreaming sweet dreams as the breezes blew slow.
